## Typed Relations

- `requires`: Hard prerequisite. The requires graph must be acyclic.
- `gates`: A safety or evidence gate that may veto a named phase.
- `runs_after`: Ordering constraint only when both skills are independently selected.
- `supports`: Advisory evidence relationship that never auto-activates its target.
- `conflicts_with`: Skills that cannot own the same action or decision domain simultaneously.
- `consumes`: Artifact or decision type read by the skill.
- `superseded_by`: Lifecycle replacement; not an execution dependency.
